quality_guards: The appropriate transport controls depend on site layout, vehicle types, pedestrian numbers, tasks, lighting and operating conditions.
Workplace-transport evidence is site- and activity-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collision probability.
Driving controls depend on the driver, vehicle, route, journey duration, schedule, weather, load and work demands.
Driving-for-work evidence is journey-, vehicle- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level road-risk probability.
Lift-truck controls depend on truck type, attachment, load, surface, slopes, visibility, pedestrian interaction and operating environment.
Lift-truck evidence is equipment-, load-, operator- and site-specific and is not an exact parcel-level accident probability.
Warehouse controls depend on goods, racking, handling methods, traffic, staffing, facility layout and operating peaks.
Warehousing evidence is facility-, stock- and activity-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Public-protection controls depend on the work, neighbourhood, adjacent land use, visitors and vulnerable groups.
Construction public-protection evidence is site- and project-specific and is not an exact parcel-level trespass or injury probability.
Welfare provision depends on workforce size, disability needs, work type, hazards, remoteness and working patterns.
Welfare evidence is workplace- and workforce-specific and is not an exact parcel-level health-readiness probability.
Sign selection depends on residual risk, audience, visibility, environment, route design and controls already in place.
Safety-sign evidence is hazard- and workplace-specific and is not an exact parcel-level compliance or injury probability.
Emergency arrangements depend on hazards, occupancy, vulnerable people, processes, site layout, communications and available responders.
Emergency-procedure evidence is premises- and scenario-specific and is not an exact parcel-level incident probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
